name: NF-10/NF-11 bounded offline optional recommendation resolver and canonical routing

files_create.purpose: Nizam-owned pure recommendation/routing and thin no-follow local I/O boundary; read-only CLI; no DS format replacement.
Dedicated executable high-risk filesystem/read/execution isolation controls and concurrent-change negative tests using private temporary synthetic roots.
Synthetic contextual route and selected-only host entrypoint access fixtures; direct/equivalent authoring preserves governing requirements.

files_modify.purpose: Extend existing catalogue suite with local resolver observations and independently authored synthetic host inventory tests.
Single concise canonical optional specialist route and matching version update; no body duplication.
Match SKILL.md version and only add capability if indexed by parent-approved NIZAM change.
Document explicit host input/API, no reads when disabled, advisory output and selected required-check preservation.
Reference resolver and one concise task routing mapping under existing optional authority contract.
Index resolver or routing source only if required by intentional-subset governance index semantics.

non_goals: No consumer package execution or body loading by resolver, process invocation, network/acquisition, install/update/uninstall, arbitrary schema retrieval, source repair or filesystem writes.
No actual DS package schema/inventory contract implemented from guesses; no DS26 fixture closure, DS27 package acceptance, NF16 exact pair, NF17 live pilot or qualification claim.
No active recommended catalogue entries, lifecycle/run_state/circuit-counter changes, host acceptance/approval, release/self-adoption or permission elevation.
No unrelated governance rewrites, fourth routing skill, hosted registry, broad ambient discovery or mandatory cross-repo CI dependency.

acceptance_requirements.requirement: Disabled integration returns an advisory disabled result before reading package roots, inventories or entrypoint bodies; only explicit configuration/catalogue metadata may be read. No network, process execution or mutation in any mode.

Explicit configured roots may be absolute host paths; inventory/package-relative paths must never be absolute, traversing, NUL-bearing or ambiguous. Anchor one canonical explicitly configured root by no-follow directory descriptors and verify its identity. Resolve only the selected package under that anchored root; no ambient scan or unrelated package enumeration. Reject symlinked roots/ancestors/files, hardlinked or special files, concurrent ancestor replacement and switched links without reading escaping targets. Unsupported no-follow/dir_fd capabilities yield unverified without unsafe fallback.

An ordinary compatible offer requires lifecycle recommended AND host-verified released-catalogue activation AND a separately trusted accepted qualification binding the exact selected package bytes, source commit, DS inventory identity, neutral contracts and current framework source/payload/compatibility-surface digests. Candidate, verified, unreleased recommended and withdrawn never offer or return compatible. Missing, forged, self-asserted, wrong-pair or stale-surface trust proof yields unverified/incompatible. A schema-valid catalogue, matching strings or report producer assertions never establish trust.

For supported Nizam host observation v1, read/hash each regular file once from stable no-follow descriptors, bind size/inode/device and before/after timestamps, verify directory/root identities and exact complete file set before/after, and derive the canonical host digest from those same assessed bytes. Reject added/untracked files, duplicates/path collisions, missing files, links, directories in file records, concurrent changes or resource-bound overflow. No exclusions in v1. DS inventory digests and self-exclusion rules are distinct, never assumed equal to host observation digest. Enforce operation-wide visited-entry and visited-directory limits including empty directories using incremental enumeration; directory-only fan-out must fail before unbounded allocation or traversal.

Use the versioned Nizam-owned host observation and trusted qualification interfaces defined in host_input_contract below. Untrusted configuration/inventory/catalogue data cannot select a verifier, module, command, credential or trust store, set accepted=true or shrink required scope. A programmatically installed host verifier must have pre-established trust/provenance and verify accepted exact-pair evidence under the existing release mechanism; absent real supported adapter/DS27 mapping means no real-package compatible result. Synthetic fixture verifiers demonstrate only Nizam control flow, never real qualification.

Catalogue lifecycle candidate/verified/recommended/withdrawn is distinct from local observations compatible/missing/unverified/incompatible/withdrawn. Verified is preactivation only and never offers a recommendation. Declined/disabled/inaccessible remain advisory to generic Nizam; selected required assurance persists or remains blocked pending policy-authorized equivalent evidence.

Compute at most one contextual route (README -> readme-docs; learner tutorial -> tutorial-docs; architecture/reference/operations -> software-docs), but offer it only after recommended+released activation and trusted exact-pair qualification pass. Verified/candidate/unreleased metadata may identify a provisional route for diagnostics but never activate an offer. Unrelated code work gets none; ambiguous context requires explicit selection.

Resolver may read selected-package file bytes solely for integrity hashing, including its declared entrypoint, but never parses, discloses or loads skill bodies into agent instructions or executes package code. It returns only the selected relevant entrypoint identity/path after integrity and trust checks. The host deliberately loads only that selected relevant entrypoint under existing permission policy. Tests prove unrelated package entrypoints are never opened.

Same canonical task classification, authorization and selected assurance requirements apply to recommended, alternate or direct authoring. Presence of catalogue/package never adopts governance, enables execution, installs/updates/removes packages, changes .nizam or grants a verdict.

DS27 immutable packages are unavailable. Deterministic local tests use independently authored synthetic host inventory only; they are not DS contract fixtures, a DS26 handoff, exact-pair compatibility or behavioral qualification. No active recommendations are introduced.

A withdrawn entry preserves identity/reason/history while resolver returns withdrawn and performs no uninstall, upgrade, state/counter mutation or selected requirement erasure. Existing valid released recommendation pins are unchanged.

Positive synthetic trusted-host fixture plus negative missing trust, forged signature/provenance, arbitrary accepted=true JSON, different producer/store, mismatched framework SHA, payload/surface digest, DS inventory/package identity, changed required contracts, and altered released catalogue digest must discriminate exact trusted binding. No real DS compatibility claim is possible until an accepted verifier mapping exists.

Verified exact local bytes and trusted qualification still yield unactivated/unverified with no offer. Recommended without released-catalogue acceptance similarly yields no offer. Only an exact accepted released recommendation may offer, with no execution/install permission.

verification.detail: Offline synthetic matrix with filesystem/process/network mutation sentinels; disabled missing-root/poison-path control; competing file/ancestor replacements; all lifecycle/local availability combinations; no private input. Explicit arbitrary accepted=true/forged/missing proof, wrong pair/source/surface/contracts/host digest, verified and unreleased-recommended nonactivation controls; canonical host digest known-answer and unsupported DS mapping controls.

Dedicated subprocess/temp-root suite proving no-read sentinels outside roots, escaping/broken/link swaps, descriptor race identity, special files, irrelevant skill body poison and zero package execution/network/mutations. This is the high-risk isolation-boundary suite; it must fail on unsafe mutant implementations. Real no-follow/dir_fd capability detection, canonical absolute-root control, complete no-exclusion scoped inventory, bound-overflow, file/ancestor race and unsupported-host fail-closed cases. Required discriminating controls: too many empty directories at allowed depth with zero files/bytes must exhaust directory/entry budgets and yield no offer; excessive total entries across repeated scans must fail; a small valid tree containing empty directories and a selected entrypoint must pass synthetic observation. Assert incremental enumeration does not materialize over-limit entries before rejecting.
README/tutorial/reference/operations/code/ambiguous fixtures, decline/alternate method and selected required-check persistence; only selected entrypoint opened by synthetic host harness.
C13 index/manifest parity and containment remain intact after canonical route version bump.
Full current control suite; no cross-repo package dependency.
Payload validates with no DS package installed or accessible; no recommendation activation.

evidence_convention: Exclusive start_path capture with actual argv/exit/environment/input identity; tests-only preimplementation observation retained as semantic-negative; source frozen and manifest digested before independent QA; no overwrite or private-source diagnostics.

role_allocation.separation: Resolver revision3 is authored by optional_scaffold in Planner-only role. Root Orchestrator arranges distinct Generator, Validator and Evaluator sessions; neither product implementation nor evaluation by this Planner. Both independent Loop1 gates must approve before implementation.

prerequisites.NF-05: Canonical consumer route corrective implementation must be accepted before NF11.
prerequisites.DS-27: Unavailable; limits this work to Nizam-owned API and synthetic host-inventory observations. No actual DS package compatibility closed.

preconditions: Freeze independent NF22 corrective source before optional product edits.
High-risk capability preflight and named full role separation recorded.
Validator reviews approved contract and explicit no-follow/race strategy, including portability limits; unsupported host protection fails closed rather than pretending containment.
Operator mandate authorizes implementation and normal PR delivery only; actual release/qualification/publication gates remain unchanged.
baseline_plan: After contract approval, add discriminating tests first and capture current missing-resolver/routing behavior before implementation. Treat this as missing optional capability, not a defect already affecting core compliance. Preserve before/after boundary proof and mutant unsafe-root/read negative controls.
qa_plan: Evaluator independently executes every declared check in fresh process/private temp roots from committed frozen source, adds an adversarial boundary control, records exact source/surface digest and all unassessed conditions. Dedicated isolation suite must meaningfully exercise no-read boundaries; mocked sentinels alone do not establish real containment.

host_input_contract.ownership: Nizam host observation API only; not a DS package manifest, archive format, self-exclusion rule, neutral contract or release attestation schema.
host_input_contract.configuration: Enabled flag, explicit selected task/skill, explicit absolute canonical root and one package-relative path. Root/inventory/trust fields are not read when disabled. No untrusted plugin path, import hook, executable command, remote URL retrieval or trust-authority switch.
host_input_contract.file_records: Complete selected-root regular file records {path, size, sha256}; include hidden/untracked files and selected entrypoint, no exclusions. path is exact case-sensitive ASCII POSIX relative path with [A-Za-z0-9._/-] characters, no empty/dot/dotdot components, leading slash, backslash or NUL. Unique paths sorted lexicographically; no canonical rewriting. sha256 is 64 lower hex; size is nonnegative integer.
host_input_contract.canonicalization: ASCII bytes of json.dumps({"version":"nizam-local-observation/1","files":sorted_records},sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=True), with no trailing newline; sorted_records contain only path,size,sha256 fields derived from the same assessed bytes. host_observation_sha256 is SHA256 of those canonical bytes. It is NEVER compared as though it were the DS inventory digest.
host_input_contract.limits_policy: Exceeding any bound, unsafe path/host capability, unsupported observation format or unknown DS mapping fails closed (unverified/incompatible as appropriate); never silently truncate scope or ignore a file. Empty-directory and entry fan-out consume total visit budgets even when file count and aggregate bytes are zero; these are finite work bounds, not merely output-size limits.
host_input_contract.package_identity_binding: Trusted host verifier must bind independently accepted package source/DS inventory/archive identity and supported contract versions to the actual host_observation_sha256 and declared entrypoint, using accepted DS27 format/self-exclusion rules. No such real adapter is supplied by this work; unknown or unassessable DS identity remains unverified. Nizam v1 makes no assumptions about DS manifest self-exclusion or reproducible archive metadata.

qualification_trust_interface.injection: Only trusted host application code may programmatically install a bounded local qualification verifier/context before invoking resolver. The CLI defaults to no trusted verifier; JSON/catalogue/report fields cannot create or select one. No dynamic imports or execution from input.
qualification_trust_interface.provenance: Host owns an out-of-band pinned producer/trust mechanism and immutable accepted qualification proof under existing release policy. Its verifier checks producer/signature/integrity and acceptance without network or source mutation, and reports the exact binding. A submitted accepted=true or producer string alone is never an authenticated context.
required_binding: qualification proof digest and trusted producer identity
released catalogue source and digest plus selected recommended entry identity
exact package name/version/source revision/DS inventory digest and archive checksum where accepted profile requires it
host observation v1 digest and selected entrypoint
framework source commit, payload digest and compatibility-surface digest
accepted neutral contract versions and qualification scope/limitations
qualification_trust_interface.failure: Absent/unsupported verifier, untrusted or invalid proof, mismatched binding, unverifiable release activation, expired/withdrawn evidence or incomplete profile produces no compatible offer. Resolver never synthesizes host acceptance, qualification, release sign-off or package execution permission.
qualification_trust_interface.synthetic_test_boundary: A fixed in-test trusted verifier with fictional metadata is installed by test harness code only. Test results are labeled synthetic Nizam host-interface tests and never DS conformance, exact-pair qualification or evidence that public recommendation may activate.

host_input_contract.traversal_accounting: One finite operation-wide budget spans all initial/final/verification walks. Count every observed directory entry and every visited directory, including the selected root and empty directories, on each visit; repeated walks consume the same budget. Enumerate directory entries incrementally with bounded per-entry processing before any sort/materialization. Stop before processing an over-budget entry, reject the observation without truncating its claimed complete scope, and return no compatible offer. Never use an unbounded listdir/read-all to discover that a bound was exceeded.

revision_history.change: Define trusted accepted/released exact-pair proof boundary, prohibit verified/unreleased offers, specify bounded Nizam host canonical inventory separate from unsupported DS rules.

Bound cumulative visited entries/directories including empty directories and all repeated walks; require incremental enumeration before materialization plus fan-out overflow and bounded valid-tree controls. Clarify hash reads do not load body instructions.
